zh.title: PlaneSense規劃為71架Pilatus飛機加裝Gogo衛星Wi-Fi
zh.summary: PlaneSense規劃於2027年底前為71架Pilatus飛機加裝衛星Wi-Fi。
body: PlaneSense規劃在2027年底前，為旗下全部71架Pilatus飛機加裝Gogo Galileo衛星Wi-Fi。PlaneSense於2026年10月15日宣佈選定該系統，協議涵蓋現有機隊及未來交付的飛機。
PlaneSense表示，測試顯示該系統可支援數名乘客同時串流影片、參加視訊會議及使用其他線上服務。首架配備Galileo的PC-24預定於2026年10月下旬交付。這套服務將透過Eutelsat OneWeb衛星網路，為PC-12渦輪螺旋槳飛機及PC-24噴射機上的乘客提供網路連線。

en.title: PlaneSense plans Galileo satellite Wi-Fi for all 71 Pilatus aircraft
en.summary: PlaneSense plans Galileo satellite Wi-Fi for 71 Pilatus aircraft by the end of 2027.
body: PlaneSense plans to equip all 71 of its Pilatus aircraft with Gogo Galileo satellite Wi-Fi by the end of 2027. PlaneSense announced its selection of the system on October 15, 2026. The agreement covers its current fleet and future aircraft deliveries. The aircraft include PC-12 turboprops and PC-24 jets.

PlaneSense said testing showed the system could support several passengers streaming video, joining video meetings and using other online services at the same time. The first PC-24 fitted with Galileo is scheduled for delivery in late October 2026. The service will provide passengers aboard the PC-12 and PC-24 aircraft with internet access through the Eutelsat OneWeb satellite network.

zh.title: 美國TSA突然停止301座機場登機門通道擴建
zh.summary: 美國TSA突然停止301座額外機場的登機門通道擴建；旅客登機門通行選項減少
body: 美國運輸安全管理局（TSA）突然停止一項涵蓋美國多座機場的登機門通道擴建計畫。
根據Simple Flying報導，這項名為Gateside的擴建原定在301座額外機場實施，如今已經中止。
報導指出，擴建停止後，旅客在登機門區域可使用的通行選項隨之減少。
目前取得的資料僅為Simple Flying的報導摘要，未包含TSA的說法、停止原因或生效時間。

en.title: TSA suddenly halts gate-access expansion at 301 more US airports
en.summary: TSA abruptly halts its Gateside expansion at 301 additional US airports; travelers left with fewer gate-access options
body: The Transportation Security Administration has abruptly halted a gate-access expansion covering airports across the United States.
According to Simple Flying, the expansion, known as Gateside, had been planned for 301 additional airports and has now been stopped.
The report states that travelers are left with fewer gate-access options as a result of the halt.
The available material is limited to the Simple Flying report summary; it does not include a TSA statement, the reason for the halt or an effective date.
